Harman support page (CROWN PZM30D, read through a search summary 2026-11-12): balanced 3-pin male XLR output, phantom 12 to 48 V, detachable cable, 152 x 127 x 19 mm, 240 ohm. The cable end is modelled as the output on the rear edge of the plate, a stand-in position: the XLR ring (23 mm) is taller than the 19 mm plate, so the device could not meet the catalogue ring rule and is beta-modelled. 152 x 127 x 19 mm (dealer, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
